item.title: Critical Keycloak Password Reset Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Take Over Any Account
item.summary: Red Hat and the Keycloak project have released patches to address a critical security flaw in the open-source identity and access management server that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over any user account by forcing a password reset.
